name: Voice note
description: A chat voice message pops in beside the speaker's round photo. Its waveform records in, bar by bar, from the speaker's real voice, with a gold line at the edge. A label types in, Send is pressed with a ripple, 'Delivered' ticks on, and it flies off.
when: When you talk about sending a voice note, a message to someone, or 'I just tell it what to do'.
needs: a round photo of the speaker (avatar.png)
the waveform (wave.js, made in the steps)
the cut time where it starts
